title: Sooji Halwa
description: A quick Punjabi-style semolina halwa roasted in ghee and sweetened with milk, ideal for prasad or an after-dinner sweet.
steps: Warm the milk and water together with the sugar in a saucepan and keep it just hot.
Heat the ghee in a heavy pan and roast the sooji on low heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant and light golden, about 8 minutes.
Add the almonds and raisins and stir for 30 seconds.
Carefully pour in the hot milk mixture, standing back as it will splutter.
Stir briskly, add the cardamom and cook until the halwa thickens and leaves the sides of the pan.
Cover for 2 minutes and serve warm.
